'''PL-40112-CE-021105''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Salfrem system]], within the forbidden [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] known as [[the Wastes]]. The planet was the home of [[Bertroff Hissa]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]]-[[Sephi/Legends|Sephi]] [[Hybrid/Legends|hybrid]] who ended up becoming [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. PL-40112-CE-021105 remained uncharted until the Empire launched a survey. However, the surveyors awoke an ancient horde of [[Rozzum]], a [[Species/Legends|species]] of inter-dimensional monsters. The Imperials were forced to ally with the [[Near-Human]]s who lived on PL-40112-CE-021105 in order to vanquish the creatures. Ultimately, only two survived the encounter: Hissa, and the ranking Imperial officer from Naboo, [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Quarsh Panaka/Legends|Quarsh Panaka]].
